_comment: Example profile. Copy to ~/.config/asbx/profiles/ and edit - your real hosts and secret paths belong there, not in version control.

capabilities.label: admin API
capabilities._comment_methods: POST is not a write here: /__admin/requests/find is a search. Method is a poor proxy for danger on this API, so the deny list below carries the weight.
capabilities._comment_deny: A shared WireMock is shared with other people. These endpoints hit all of them: reset clears the whole request journal, mappings/reset drops every stub, shutdown stops the server. Scoped deletes (requests/remove with a RequestPattern) stay available.
capabilities._comment_secret: pass: keeps credentials in the store you already back up. keychain:SERVICE:ACCOUNT works too.
